{{Infobox auto}}

'''Toadstool stroganoff''' is the meal of the red [[mushroom]]. It heals {{Value|Toadstool Stroganoff|heals}} but poisons the eater for {{Value|Toadstool Stroganoff|duration|effect=Poison}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/red_mushroom_stroganoff.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A raw red mushroom, a [[steak]], dough, a [[Milk Bottle|milk bottle]] and a [[bowl]]. Obtaining a [[Braised Toadstool|braised toadstool]] is meant to unlock the recipe, but a pack bug keeps it out of the recipe book (see [[Known bugs]]). The milk bottle's glass bottle isn't returned.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes {{Value|Toadstool Stroganoff|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Toadstool Stroganoff|heals}} and gives {{EffectLink|Poison}} {{Value|Toadstool Stroganoff|level|effect=Poison}} for {{Value|Toadstool Stroganoff|duration|effect=Poison|format=clock}}, which deals more damage than the food heals. The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_30.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>
